definitions.gloss: very human; down-to-earth; showing human weaknesses
definitions.explanation: Showing the feelings, desires and weaknesses typical of ordinary people. Usually said with warmth, of someone admired or important who turns out to be as fallible as anyone else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{人間臭|にんげんくさ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{人間臭|にんげんくさ}い⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Though a god, he has some very human traits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人間臭|にんげんくさ}い{弱|よわ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The very human weaknesses of a hero who seems perfect are what makes this novel appealing.

notes:
From ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ + ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ (smelling of). Unlike most -⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ words ({古臭|ふるくさ}い, ⟦{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い→面倒臭い：16345_mendoukusai⟧), it is usually positive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人間臭|にんげんくさ}い⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: a human side
- {人間臭|にんげんくさ}い⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧: a human side (to someone)
- {人間臭|にんげんくさ}さ: human quality, humanity (noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧らしい: human, humane — a life or treatment fit for a human being; no hint of weakness
- {人間味|にんげんみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: warm, with a human touch — stresses kindness rather than flaws
